outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomic cluster image is a micrograph/spatial overlay, not a plot of averaged data.
H&E images with manual annotation are micrographs, not a plot showing averages.
Spatial expression maps are heatmap-style visualizations overlaid on tissue images, not averaged bar/summary plots requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing running enrichment score, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold change values for each gene (derived from differential expression analysis across many spots/cells) without any individual data points overlaid, obscuring the underlying variability of the aggregated measurements.
